title: Thermal-data feasibility samples for three Earth AOIs, Jezero, and the lunar south polar 80–90S profile

earth.license_note: No SPDX identifier assigned. LP DAAC guidance states that current products have no restrictions on reuse, sale, or redistribution and requests proper citation; confirm the product DOI citation before reuse.
earth.measurement: Daily daytime and nighttime 1 km land-surface temperature retrieved from clear-sky thermal infrared radiance, not air temperature.
earth.retrieval: MOD11A1.061 uses the generalized split-window LST retrieval. Atmospheric transmission and surface emissivity estimates affect the result; the audit retains but does not normalize those effects across AOIs.
earth.native_grid: Sinusoidal MODIS tile grid; 1200 x 1200 cells; sphere radius 6371007.181 m; nominal 1 km product, grid spacing about 926.625 m.
earth.units: K; raw LST scale 0.02 K. Local solar view time scale 0.1 h.
earth.qa: Mandatory QA bits 1-0: 00 produced/good, 01 produced/other quality, 10 not produced/cloud, 11 not produced/other; LST valid raw range 7500..65535; fill 0.
earth.temporal: Daily snapshots on four 2023 equinox/solstice dates. Per-pixel local solar observation time.

moon.product: LRO Diviner GDR Level 2 south polar maps, channel TB3
moon.provider: NASA PDS Geosciences Node / Washington University in St. Louis
moon.license_note: No SPDX identifier is assigned. The PDS Geosciences Node states archived PDS data sets are public domain and may be used freely; cite the data set as required by its citation policy.
moon.measurement: Channel 3 brightness temperature, 7.55–8.05 micrometres; a spectral radiometric proxy, not an emissivity-normalized kinetic temperature or the MODIS LST retrieval.
moon.crs: Moon body-fixed DE421, planetocentric south polar stereographic; spherical radius 1737.4 km.
moon.grid: 126.347 pixels/degree; nominal map posting 240 m/pixel. Footprint response is modeled in mapping; an effective resolution in metres is not specified for this sample.
moon.units: K; scale 0.02, offset 0; missing -32768. Count estimate scale 0.01, offset 0. Error estimate scale 0.01, offset 200 K. Local time scale 1/12 h, offset 2730.00273000273, missing -32768.
moon.qa: Retain TB3 in the GDR description 10–450 K range, positive count estimate and present error estimate; 2 km support rule additionally requires 80% valid posting centres.
moon.temporal: 27-day LRO mapping cycles; each cycle split into local-time day 06–18 and night 18–06. Local time drifts across longitude.
moon.interpretation_limit: The GDR bins and averages radiance-derived channel brightness temperatures. This audit does not invert TB3 to kinetic temperature with an emissivity model, and does not match incidence, shadow or seasonal illumination.

mars.product: MGS TES Derived Thermal Inertia Maps V1.0
mars.license_note: No SPDX identifier is assigned. The PDS Geosciences Node states archived PDS data sets are public domain and may be used freely; cite the data set as required by its citation policy.
mars.measurement: Model-derived thermal inertia from TES bolometer surface-temperature observations; not a direct temperature observation.
mars.crs: Mars planetocentric, east-positive longitude, sphere radius 3396.0 km.
mars.grid: 20 pixels/degree; about 2.96 km north-south and 2.81 km east-west at Jezero latitude.
mars.units: J/(m^2 K sqrt(s)); computed range 5–5000. Dayside/nightside maps with interpolation mask (mask 0 infilled, 1 directly mapped).
mars.temporal: Thermal inertia derived from dayside or nightside observations over three Mars years, February 1999–April 2004; not a single-time temperature map.
mars.derivation_note: The PDS profile describes the map product as a separate thermal-inertia derivation and warns that the model used for the published TES bolometer tables does not reproduce these maps. It points to Putzig and Mellon (2007) and Putzig et al. (2005) for product-specific derivation details. Related TES thermal-model documentation identifies local time, season, latitude, thermal inertia, albedo, surface pressure and dust opacity as interacting parameters, with atmospheric radiative effects. The audit does not recreate that inversion or treat map values as observations.

analysis_grid.cell_support_rules_are: Experiment QA thresholds, not published instrument guarantees.

processing.earth: Transform MODIS sinusoidal pixel centres to local UTM. Apply the K-017 NASADEM SWBD value at each native centre (0=land, 255=water). A target cell is land when its centre lies in the K-017 AOI bounds and is land by SWBD. Count good LST source centres per target cell; good means raw LST 7500..65535 and mandatory QA bits 1-0 equal 00. Retain the product's additional data-quality, emissivity-error and LST-error flag counts for passing pixels. Report coverage only if at least three land centres exist and at least 75% pass mandatory QA.
processing.moon: Use the K-004 304x304 polar grid and projected cap radius. Bin source map posting centres into 2 km cells without resampling values. Retain TB3 10..450 K with positive count product and present error product. Coverage-qualified cell requires at least 80% of posting centres valid; this is map-data coverage, not independent observation count or physical effective resolution.
processing.mars: Select the native 20 px/degree TES source pixel centres inside the spherical Jezero geometry. Use the product interpolation mask to separate direct from infilled pixels. Summarize direct pixels only; do not assign TES values to the finer 2 km target grid. This audit records that thermal inertia is an inversion output sensitive to observing time, season, albedo, surface pressure and dust opacity; it does not recreate the product model.
processing.null_policy: Unavailable temperature or local-time summaries remain JSON null; missing data are not zero-filled.
processing.versions: K-004 and K-017 reference-manifest SHA-256 values and the analysis code SHA-256 are emitted under analysis after every run.

decision.feature: One shared surface thermal measurement scored across Earth, Mars, and Moon in K-010.
decision.reason: Earth MOD11A1 and lunar Diviner TB3 have distinct radiometric retrievals, spectral responses, temporal aggregation and local-time conditions; Mars TES input is derived thermal inertia, not temperature. TES posting near Jezero also exceeds the 2 km target cell.
decision.follow_up: If pursued, evaluate temperature-only and thermal-inertia features as separate P1 research cards with explicit shared measurand, seasonal/local-time matching, QA, support, null handling and coverage rules. No production scoring changes in K-047.

target_grid.support_rule: at least 3 native land pixel centres and 75% or more of those centres with good mandatory QA

day.qa_rule: TB3 in the PDS-described 10–450 K range, a positive count estimate, a present error estimate, and at least 80% of native posting centres valid per 2 km target cell.

night.qa_rule: TB3 in the PDS-described 10–450 K range, a positive count estimate, a present error estimate, and at least 80% of native posting centres valid per 2 km target cell.

independent_2km_target_support.reason: The native TES posting near Jezero (about 2.8–3.0 km) is coarser than the 2 km target cell; no independent per-cell target values are assigned.
